$comment: Committed fixture for the upstream-sync dry-run (DESIGN §7.2). A frozen snapshot of an `upstream/dev` changed-files list so the dry-run never performs a live git fetch or touches a remote. `from`/`to` are the synthetic submodule-pointer SHAs the synthetic PR would bump between; `files` are vendor-relative POSIX paths fed to the §7.3 classifier.
